sec.title: September 5 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 844)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 5** across Hollywood songwriter Mack Gordon on *The Fitch Bandwagon* for Fitch Shampoo (1943), British comedy legends Eric Morecambe and Ernie Wise on *The Morecambe and Wise Show* (1976), two modern radio dramas on Jim French's *Imagination Theatre* (Chick Bowdrie western in 2004; Harry Nile mystery in 2010), Irish island folklore on *Twenty Years A-Growing* (1977), and symphony woodwinds education on *Your Symphony Scrapbook* (1953), Mack Gordon (1943), Arthur Fiedler (1953), Eric Morecambe & Ernie Wise (1976), and Larry Albert (2010):
